issue.title: ACE agent-session render tests fail: --plan turn prompt renders as '...' and prompt hints drop out of body mappings

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Proposed by E3 phases sase-1ko.3 (note #1), sase-1ko.5 (note #1), and sase-1ko.7 (note #10); each
reproduced on its clean base, and none of E3's commits touch the ACE agent display. The sase-1ko land
agent reran them serially (`pytest -n 0`) on master 88acef6234 and every node failed again, so they are
deterministic, not flakes:

- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_agent_session_render.py::test_agent_session_conversation_sections_are_always_full
  (all 5 fold-level params): `'plan prompt line 15' in ...` fails because the --plan turn's prompt is
  rendered as `...` instead of full conversation text.
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_agent_session_hints.py::test_agent_session_content_hints_are_full_at_both_levels_and_use_phase_workspace
  (prompt paths missing from body hint mappings; line 168).
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_agent_session_hints.py::test_session_collapsed_detached_macro_skips_markers
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_raw_prompt_hints.py::TestAgentRawPromptHintMode::test_hint_mode_renders_raw_prompt_for_terminal_agent
  (AssertionError in _agent_display_metadata_helpers.py:84/102)
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_prompt_semantic.py::test_agent_macro_and_prompt_receive_roles_replies_do_not

These look like one agent-session prompt rendering/hint regression. The neighbouring raw-prompt and
duplicate-hint failures are tracked by sase-1ia and sase-1hy; this cluster is not named by either.
Root cause not identified.

issue.creation_reason: Several E3 phases proposed these ACE TUI failures as clean-base reds outside their scope; no existing task names this agent-session rendering cluster.

payload.description: Adjacent agent-display raw-prompt rendering failures; a shared prompt-precedence root cause is plausible
